title: Quick check: React Server Components in Frameworks

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “React Server Components in Frameworks”?
options: The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.

The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
questions.answer_key: Framework support depends on the selected React framework/runtime and must respect server/client boundaries.
